Samantha Camel - Founder
Hello beauties!!! I'm Samantha Camel. I've worn multiple hats in my professional journey, starting as a group exercise instructor and dental assistant. My fascination with the realm of beauty has been a constant thread throughout. I've even ventured into beauty pageants in my earlier years, which significantly influenced my path.
Amid the vibrant chaos of managing a bustling household with my devoted husband and five wonderful children, I embarked on a fresh chapter in 2018 - the birth of Bronze Beauties. What initiated as a mobile spray tanning endeavor has organically evolved into a comprehensive range of services. This array encompasses everything from holistic spray tanning and teeth whitening to the artistry of tooth gems, transformative body contouring, and attentive post-operative care.
My driving force remains rooted in helping others unlock their ultimate selves. My pride swells when I curate experiences that seamlessly interweave the aesthetics of beauty with the essence of self-care. Your unique journey holds utmost importance to me, and I'm resolutely committed to ensuring it's nothing short of extraordinary.
Miranda Rivera - Licensed Esthetician
Let's introduce you to Miranda Rivera, a licensed esthetician who absolutely loves taking care of your skin and making you feel beautiful. She got her license on July 30, 2021, and she's been working really hard to provide amazing services just for you. She attended Raphael's School of Beauty to ensure she provides the best services.
Miranda offers a  variety of treatments that show how skilled she is. She provides enticing facials that make your skin glow and feel hydrated, and she's really intricate with waxing to make your face refreshed. She can make your eyelashes look bold with lifts and tints, and she's really talented at making your eyebrows look perfect with lamination and tinting.
But there's more to Miranda than just her skills. When she's not working her magic on your skin, she's a devoted single mom to her wonderful son. She's not only passionate about making you look and feel your best, but she's also committed to creating beautiful memories with her family. So, when you're in Miranda's care, you're not just getting a beauty treatment; you're getting a piece of her dedication and love for making every moment special.

30 Tips to Keep Your Spray Tan Looking Fresh and Flawless
Jan 17
Written By
Matt
Spray tans are an easy and convenient way to get a sun-kissed glow without the damaging effects of the sun. But, like any beauty regimen, maintaining your spray tan requires some care and attention. To help keep your spray tan looking its best, here are 30 tips to maintain that perfect golden glow:
1. Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water to keep your skin moisturized and to reduce the effects of fading.
2. Avoid taking long baths or swimming, as this will strip away your tan.
3. Use a gentle moisturizer on your skin each day to keep your skin hydrated and to help extend the life of your tan.
4. Exfoliate your skin before getting a spray tan to ensure that the tan will last longer and look more even.
5. Wear loose-fitting clothing after getting a spray tan to avoid rubbing against the skin, which can cause streaks and unevenness.
6. Avoid activities that cause sweating, such as exercising or being in direct sunlight, immediately after getting a spray tan.
7. Use a gentle soap or body wash when showering to avoid stripping away your tan too quickly.
8. Always pat yourself dry, rather than rubbing, after showering.
9. Avoid using lotions and oils that contain alcohol, as this can strip away the tan.
10. Use a tan-extending moisturizer to keep your tan looking fresh and vibrant.
11. Avoid exfoliating your skin until your spray tan has completely faded.
12. If you’re using a sunless tanning lotion or spray, apply a light coat of moisturizer first to help the product go on more evenly.
13. When showering, avoid using strong soaps and hot water, as this can strip away your tan.
14. Avoid using any harsh scrubbing products on your skin, as this can cause streaks and unevenness.
15. Avoid using any acidic cleansers or toners on your face, as this can strip away your tan.
16. Avoid using any harsh shaving creams, as this can also strip away your tan.
17. Use a light facial moisturizer after shaving to help keep your skin hydrated and to help extend the life of your tan.
18. Avoid using any makeup removers that contain alcohol, as this can strip away your tan.
19. Use a gentle makeup remover to avoid stripping away your tan.
20. Wear protective clothing when in the sun to avoid fading your tan.
21. Apply a light layer of sunscreen with a minimum SPF of 30 when spending time in the sun to protect your skin and help maintain your tan.
22. Avoid using any facial scrubs or exfoliators that contain harsh ingredients, such as alpha-hydroxy acids, as this can strip away your tan.
23. Always wear gloves when cleaning to avoid any harsh chemicals stripping away your tan.
24. Avoid hot tubs, as the chemicals and heat can strip away your tan.
25. Avoid using any makeup or beauty products that contain alcohol, as this can strip away your tan.
26. Always use a tan-extending moisturizer when your tan starts to fade to help keep it looking fresh and vibrant.
27. Avoid chlorinated pools, as the chemicals can strip away your tan.
28. If you’re using a sunless tanning lotion or spray, exfoliate your skin first and apply a light coat of moisturizer before applying the product.
29. Use a tan-extending body wash when showering to help keep your tan looking fresh and vibrant.
30. If you’re using a sunless tanning lotion or spray, avoid using it on areas of your body that are prone to sweating, such as your armpits, as this can cause streaks and unevenness.

Getting a spray tan can be a great way to give yourself a beautiful, glowing complexion. However, in order to achieve the best results, it’s important to take the necessary steps to prepare your skin beforehand. Exfoliation is an essential part of the pre-tanning process, as it can help to remove any dead skin cells and create a smooth surface for the tanner to work on. Here, we explore how exfoliation can improve your spray tan, and discuss the best ways to do it. When you exfoliate your skin before you get a spray tan, you are helping to remove any excess build-up of dead skin cells, dirt and oils. This can help to create a more even surface for the tanner to work with, resulting in a more even and natural-looking tan. If you don’t exfoliate, the dead skin cells can cause the tanner to appear streaky or patchy. It’s important to exfoliate your skin at least 24 hours before you have a spray tan, as this will give you time to properly moisturize and hydrate your skin. This will help to prevent the tanner from clinging to any dry patches or areas of rough skin. When it comes to exfoliating, there are a few different methods you can use. For a thorough exfoliation, you can use a body scrub in the shower or bath. Alternatively, you can use a loofah or exfoliating body mitt. If you’re looking for a gentler exfoliation, you can use a glycolic acid-based gel or cream. Whichever method you choose, be sure to use circular motions to avoid any irritation. Take your time and focus on areas such as your elbows, knees and feet, as these are more prone to dryness and can benefit from extra exfoliation. Once you’ve exfoliated, it’s important to moisturize your skin. This will help to ensure that your skin is properly hydrated and that the tanner won’t cling to any dry patches. Overall, exfoliation is an important step in the pre-tanning process. By taking the time to exfoliate your skin, you can help to create a more even surface for the tanner and achieve a more natural-looking, even tan.

Laser Liposuction: The Modern Solution for Targeting Fat
Jan 2

Matt
Laser liposuction is a non-invasive procedure that uses lasers to melt away fat cells, resulting in a slimmer, more contoured appearance. It is a popular choice for people who want to target specific areas of fat, such as the stomach, thighs, or arms, and who want to avoid the risks and downtime associated with traditional liposuction surgery. Here are a few reasons why laser liposuction can be beneficial:
Quick recovery time. Laser liposuction is a minimally-invasive procedure that does not require any incisions or stitches. This means that the recovery time is much shorter than it is for traditional liposuction surgery. Most people are able to return to their normal activities within a few days of the procedure.
No scarring. Because laser liposuction does not involve any incisions, there is no risk of scarring. This can be especially appealing for people who are concerned about scarring or who have a history of scarring.
Minimal discomfort. Laser liposuction is generally well-tolerated, with minimal discomfort and no need for general anesthesia. Most people experience only minor soreness or swelling after the procedure.
Precise results. Laser liposuction allows the surgeon to precisely target specific areas of fat, resulting in more precise and refined results.
Tightened skin. The laser energy used in laser liposuction can stimulate the production of collagen, which can help to tighten and firm the skin. This can be especially beneficial for people with loose or sagging skin.
When should you consider getting laser liposuction? If you are in good health and have specific areas of fat that you would like to target, laser liposuction may be a good option for you. It is not a weight loss procedure, so it is most effective for people who are at or near their ideal weight but have stubborn pockets of fat that they would like to remove. It is important to have realistic expectations and to discuss your goals with a qualified surgeon before deciding to undergo the procedure.

Why It's Time to Ditch the Tanning Bed and Try Organic Spray Tanning
Jan 2
Written By
Matt
Tanning beds have long been a popular way for people to get a tan, but in recent years, the risks of using tanning beds have become more widely known and the popularity of these devices has declined. Organic spray tanning is a safer, healthier alternative that can give you the same tanning results without the negative side effects.
One of the biggest risks of using tanning beds is the increased risk of skin cancer. Tanning beds emit UV radiation, which can damage the DNA in your skin cells and increase your risk of developing skin cancer. In fact, people who use tanning beds are 74% more likely to develop melanoma, the deadliest form of skin cancer, than those who have never used a tanning bed.
In addition to the increased risk of skin cancer, tanning beds can also cause premature aging of the skin. The UV radiation from tanning beds can break down collagen and elastin, the proteins that give skin its elasticity and strength. This can lead to wrinkles, sagging skin, and age spots.
Organic spray tanning, on the other hand, is a safe and healthy alternative that can give you the same sun-kissed glow without the risks. These tans are created with organic, natural ingredients that are applied to the skin in a fine mist. They do not contain any harmful UV radiation, so they will not increase your risk of skin cancer or cause premature aging.
Another benefit of organic spray tans is that they are customizable. You can choose the shade of tan that you want, ranging from a natural-looking glow to a deep, dark bronze. You can also choose how long you want the tan to last, so you can have a tan that lasts for just a few days or one that lasts 10 days.
In conclusion, if you want to achieve a tan without the risks associated with tanning beds, organic spray tanning is the way to go. It is a safe and healthy alternative that can give you the same beautiful, sun-kissed glow without the negative side effects.

organic-spray-tanning.text:
Organic
Spray Tan.
Spray Tan Care
What to do before your organic spray tan
While the Bronze Beauties organic spray tanning process is quick and easy, there are a few things you should do to prepare your skin for the spray tan. By following these preparation instructions, your spray tan will look great and last longer.
Book Now
Clothing
What kinds of clothing should I wear?
• Bring loose-fitting clothes to change into immediately after your spray tan
• No denim, no yoga pants, no tight bras or underwear
• Ideally, bring flip flops too
Should I wear a bra for a spray tan?
• Most people spray tan without a bra
• If you must wear one, we recommend a strapless bra or bandeau
Exfoliating
Should I exfoliate before I get a spray tan?
• Exfoliate at least 4 hours before your appointment. This gives your pores time to close to avoid discoloration
What is the best pre tan exfoliation?
• We do not recommend any particular brand, but the exfoliator must be oil free and made from organic and natural ingredients
• Exfoliating mit and actual exfoliator depend on your skin needs
Showering
Should I shower before getting a spray tan?
• Shower, shave, and exfoliate at least 4 hours before your appointment to give your pores time to close to avoid discoloration
• If you must shower right before your appointment, finish off with a cold rinse to close those poresion text goes here
Moisturizing
Should I moisturize before getting a spray tan?
• Come to your appointment with clean skin
• No lotions or other beauty products
Other Tips
Complete other beauty services first
• Complete all other beauty services first, like nails, waxing, facials, and massages
• Wax 24 hours (or more) before your appointment. Wax can stay on the skin and make it difficult for the tanning solution to hold
Book Now
After every Bronze Beauties tanning session, we know you’ll look and feel great. To ensure that your spray tan lasts as long as possible and you maintain your stunning glow, follow these spray tan aftercare instructions.
What to do after spray tan
Clothing
What kind of clothing should I wear?
• Wear loose fitting clothing until after your first shower
• No denim, no bras, and no yoga pants
• Ideally, wear a long t-shirt dress
Can I wear socks after getting a spray tan?
• You should not wear socks after a spray tan
Can I wear shoes after getting a spray tan?
• The best shoes after a spray tan include sandals & flip flops
Exfoliating
When can I exfoliate after getting a spray tan?
• Don’t exfoliate until you are ready to say goodbye
• When you are ready to say goodbye, use an exfoliating mitt to create the perfect canvas for your next tan
Showering
When can I take a shower after getting a spray tan?
• Stay away from all moisture until your first shower; this means no showers, no work outs, no cleaning, no lotions, and no liquid foundations on the skin
• Take your first shower 4 hours after your spray tan
• Do NOT go more than 24 hours after your appointment to shower
How do I wash my body after a spray tan?
• Be gentle. Use warm water, only a natural body wash, and the palms of your hands to rinse surface bronzer off your skin. You will see some bronzer wash away – this is normal!
• Avoid harsh scrubbing, hot water, soap bar, and Dove soap
• Pat yourself dry, don’t rub
How should I wash my hair after I get a spray tan?
• You should not wash you hair as it is necessary for the solution to soak in
• Keep your hair away from water for 8 hours
Moisturizing
What type of lotion should I use after a spray tan?
• Moisturize with an oil-free moisturizer
• Moisturize in the AM and PM with an oil-free moisturizer
• From Day 3 onwards, you can use our Tan Extender as your moisturizer
•  We recommend using hemp and or cocoa butter
What lotions should I avoid?
• Ensure that the lotion you use is as natural and organic as possible, which means it will include no mineral oil or oils at all • We recommended Lubriderm because it is all natural and oil free
Other Tips
What not to do
• To preserve your tan, avoid swimming, long showers, baths, steam rooms, and saunas
• Avoid harsh chemicals such as chlorine, products containing acids, massages, fashion tape, bandages, and anything else that may strip your tan
• We know it’s hard, but keep your hands off your hot self. No leg crossing or other skin to skin contact
Book Now
You Deserve The Best
You and your skin deserve the best, which is why we are so committed to offering a custom airbrush spray tan that actually protects your skin rather than damaging it. To ensure your spray tan lasts as long as possible, follow all of these preparation and aftercare instructions. If you have any other questions about spray tans and the Bronze Beauties process, check out our FAQ  page, or get in touch us with us directly by visiting our Contact page.

headings: What are the benefits of waxing?
waxing.text:
Beauty
Waxing.
Book Now
What are the benefits of waxing?
Waxing pulls the hair out by the root, so it takes much longer to grow back! Even if have to shave every day, waxing can allow you to be smooth and hair-free for 2-6 weeks.
Hair grows finer!
Hair comes back in finer and softer than it does with shaving, where shaving can give the appearance of thicker hair, due to the razor only removing the hair at skin level, blunting the ends of the hair shaft.
Waxing leaves your skin feeling silky smooth!
Waxing pulls the hair out from the root, therefore you are not left with the stubble shaving can leave.
You are less likely to get ingrown hairs with waxing!
When you shave, you only remove the hair at skin level. The end of the hair is blunt and can become trapped under the skin and begin to grow sideways. Waxing removes the entire hair from the root. The new hair grows finer and is tapered at the end, which means it is less likely to get trapped.
Does waxing hurt?
Everyone’s pain tolerance is going to be different, but it is generally very well tolerated. What you can expect is a pinprick or slight tingling sensation immediately after the wax is removed lasting a few seconds. Redness may occur for a few minutes to a few hours, depending on how sensitive you may be. After regular waxing, the discomfort lessens, which is why it is ideal to stay on schedule with Bikini and Brazilian waxing!
